description: OAuth client secret reset: missing client_id agrees and the single POST once confirmed. The confirm gate runs first, so the rejection case confirms. Confirm-gate text diverges (see report). The new secret is returned by design. A successful response must be a decodable JSON object.

cases.name: rejects a blank client_id
cases.expect_error: client_id must be a non-empty string

cases.name: rejects a path separator in client_id
cases.expect_error: client_id must not contain path separators, query separators, or traversal segments

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This resets an OAuth client secret. The new secret is only shown once. Set confirm=true to proceed.
